{{Quote|All pilots to the briefing room. This is a Class One Emergency. I repeat, all pilots to the briefing room.|A Royal Naboo Security Forces alert|<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>}}
A '''Class One Emergency''' was an emergency code used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to indicate a serious military situation within the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. When [[Station TFP-9]] was [[Battle at TFP-9|attacked]] by a hostile force, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo]] and [[Echo Flight]]s were briefed and scrambled under a Class One Emergency.<ref name="Gamer" />
